title: Ricci flow of Integrable Sigma Models, Hitchin Systems and Quantum Seiberg-Witten theory
headline: Integrable Sigma Models, Hitchin Systems, and Quantum Seiberg-Witten Theory: A Ricci Flow Approach
tldr: We construct integrable 2D sigma models via 4D Chern-Simons theory, linking their classical reduction to Hitchin systems. The resulting quantum Hitchin quantisation yields a Hamiltonian matching the Perelman operator, offering insights into one-loop reduced dynamics.
significance: This work bridges integrable field theories, geometric flows, and quantum gauge dynamics, providing a new framework for studying quantum Seiberg-Witten theory.

title: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
headline: FlexPart: Unified Image-to-3D Part Generation with Variable Granularity for Digital Asset Creation
tldr: FlexPart introduces a single model that accepts heterogeneous inputs—images, sketches, and geometric constraints—allowing users to generate 3D parts at any desired level of detail. The framework demonstrates state‑of‑the‑art quality while offering unprecedented flexibility for designers and content creators.
significance: By unifying variable‑granularity control in one model, FlexPart streamlines the 3D asset pipeline and empowers creators to tailor geometry precisely to their workflow.

title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
headline: Aligning Motion Trajectories with Vision and Language: A Platonic Proxy for Robotic Models
tldr: Robotic foundation models are usually validated with expensive closed‑loop rollouts, so researchers seek cheaper offline proxies. This study proposes that motion trajectories can serve as a Platonic representation, aligning vision, language, and movement into a shared statistical model of reality.
significance: Demonstrating that motion trajectories act as a unifying modality could accelerate the evaluation and deployment of embodied AI systems.

title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
headline: Optimizing Direct Pass@k for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity
tldr: This paper introduces a Direct Pass@k optimization technique that prunes candidate solutions early during test‑time reasoning, reducing computational cost. It demonstrates that careful pruning preserves solution quality while increasing diversity, enabling efficient real‑time inference for large language models.
significance: By enabling efficient, high‑quality inference with reduced computation, the method advances practical deployment of large reasoning models.

title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
headline: Selective Auditing for Reliable AI Decision-Making in Real-Time Systems Operations
tldr: We propose an online monitoring framework that tracks AI decisions and their confidence scores, enabling selective auditing of only low-confidence outputs. This approach improves trustworthiness and efficiency by focusing verification resources where they are most needed.
significance: By decoupling decision and verification, the method reduces latency while maintaining high reliability, a critical advance for safety-critical AI deployments.

title: OpenTac: An Open Ecosystem for Customizable, Scalable, and Transferable 3D Tactile Sensing
headline: OpenTac: Open-Source, Scalable, Real-Time 3D Tactile Skin Enabling Advanced Robotics
tldr: OpenTac introduces a modular resistive tactile skin that transforms tangential forces into pressure maps, enabling high-resolution 3D tactile sensing. The open-source ecosystem supports rapid deployment in robot control and learning, offering scalability and real-time performance.
significance: This platform democratizes tactile sensing, allowing researchers to customize and scale skins for diverse robotic tasks without costly proprietary hardware.

title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
headline: SpectralCanary: Low-Frequency Traces for Auditing Text-to-Image Model Dataset Use
tldr: SpectralCanary introduces a simple, low-frequency signal that can be embedded in a dataset before release, enabling later detection of that signal in a model’s outputs to verify fine-tuning. This method offers a practical, proactive approach to dataset-use auditing for text-to-image diffusion models.
significance: It provides a scalable, model-agnostic technique for verifying dataset provenance in generative AI.

title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
headline: Cost-Aware Abstention Enhances LLM-Based IT Ticket Routing
tldr: By incorporating explicit cost penalties, the study demonstrates that cost-aware abstention reduces misrouting in IT support tickets. The approach is evaluated offline on a 47,837-ticket dataset, comparing non-LLM and LLM classifiers.
significance: It underscores the value of cost-sensitive decision-making for automated support systems.

title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
headline: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Rapid Meta-Reinforcement Learning in Complex Tasks
tldr: METTA introduces a memory module that stores and retrieves task evidence over long horizons, enabling agents to adapt quickly during test time. By combining transformer retrieval with efficient memory, METTA reduces quadratic costs while outperforming recurrent baselines on benchmark meta‑RL tasks.
significance: METTA demonstrates that scalable memory retrieval can bridge the gap between recurrent compression and transformer scalability, advancing real‑time meta‑RL.

title: Agentic World Action Models
headline: AW-0: Bridging Predictive Dynamics and Reusable Skills in Agentic Robotics
tldr: AW-0 combines visual foresight with code-based planning to enable compositional skill reuse in robot manipulation. It grounds planning in physical dynamics, addressing gaps in current world action models.
significance: This framework unifies predictive modeling and reusable skill execution, advancing autonomous robot planning.

title: When to retire: the cultural evolution of post-reproductive oblique teaching
headline: When to Retire: Evolution of Post-Reproductive Oblique Teaching in Human Societies
tldr: Oblique teaching—instruction from non-kin—has become a cornerstone of modern institutions, yet its timing and evolutionary drivers remain unclear. This study explores how post-reproductive individuals may shape cultural transmission and when retirement benefits society.
significance: Understanding when and why post-reproductive teaching occurs can illuminate the adaptive value of extended lifespans and inform policies on elder participation.

title: Optimal galaxy magnification: generalized fundamental-plane residuals and number counts are all you need
headline: Optimal Galaxy Magnification: Using Fundamental-Plane Residuals and Number Counts
tldr: The paper derives the most efficient weak-lensing magnification statistics from galaxy flux, size, and count data. It shows that the optimal measurement splits into an optimal mean statistic based on generalized fundamental-plane residuals and total number counts.
significance: It provides a practical framework for extracting maximal cosmological information from galaxy surveys using simple, observable properties.

title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
headline: LongZero: Zero-Data Reinforcement Learning Boosts Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs without External Corpora
tldr: LongZero introduces a reinforcement learning framework that trains large language models on long, diverse, and verifiable contexts without requiring annotated data or external corpora. By synthesizing challenging examples internally, it achieves robust long-context reasoning while reducing annotation costs.
significance: This approach enables scalable, data-efficient training of LLMs for tasks demanding extended context understanding, opening new avenues for applications that rely on long-range reasoning.

title: Scaling H2 Factorization to Billion-Unknown Three-Dimensional Problems
headline: Distributed H2 Factorization Enables Billion-Unknown 3D Integral Equation Solvers for Large-Scale Applications
tldr: We introduce a distributed-memory H2 factorization solver that scales to billions of unknowns in three dimensions, overcoming communication bottlenecks through spatial box coloring and delayed Schur complement techniques. The method delivers near-linear speedup on modern HPC clusters, enabling efficient direct solves for dense integral equation matrices.
significance: This work dramatically expands the size of problems solvable by direct dense linear algebra, opening new possibilities for high-fidelity simulations in physics and engineering.

title: Rethinking Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models
headline: Reimagining Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models
tldr: Video world models generate future frames in a latent space, enabling agents to train and plan interactively. They often repurpose autoencoders from text‑to‑video systems, balancing compression cost and action latency.
significance: This approach reduces computational overhead while maintaining realistic simulation fidelity, opening new avenues for real‑time agent training.

title: VoxProg: 3D Spatial Reasoning through Voxel Programming
headline: VoxProg: Leveraging Voxel Programming for Precise 3D Spatial Reasoning in AI
tldr: VoxProg introduces a voxel-based programming framework that translates natural language spatial instructions into executable 3D object placement tasks. By explicitly constructing geometric references, it bridges the gap between language models and complex 3D scene manipulation.
significance: This approach enables language models to perform accurate 3D spatial reasoning, opening new possibilities for robotics, virtual environments, and spatial AI applications.

title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
headline: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration Enhances World Model Predictions
tldr: PhysiCalWorld calibrates unseen physics properties like mass and friction directly from visual input, reducing reliance on empirical priors. This approach improves the accuracy of dynamic predictions in world models.
significance: By integrating physics calibration, world models can generate more realistic and reliable predictions for complex environments.

title: Temporal Exploration and Rendezvous via Weisfeiler-Leman Colorings
headline: Efficient Temporal Exploration via Weisfeiler-Leman Colorings Enables Fast Vertex Coverage
tldr: We prove that any connected temporal graph can be explored in O(qn log^3 n) steps, where q is the number of 2‑WL color classes. This improves previous bounds and shows that Weisfeiler‑Leman colorings capture temporal connectivity efficiently.
significance: This result bridges graph isomorphism techniques with temporal graph traversal, offering a new tool for dynamic network analysis.

title: Geometric Algebra for Neural Networks: A Survey
headline: Survey of Geometric Algebra Techniques for Equivariant Neural Network Design
tldr: This survey reviews how geometric algebra unifies geometric primitives and transformations in neural networks, enabling multivector feature representations and built‑in equivariance. It covers foundational concepts, architectural designs, and applications across computer vision and robotics.
significance: It demonstrates how algebraic structure can embed geometric invariances directly into neural network layers.

title: ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models
headline: ALPS: Unified Visual Encoders for Prediction, Instruction, and Inspection in World Models
tldr: The paper introduces ALPS, a visual encoder that jointly captures physical state, language alignment, and pixel reconstruction, enabling world models to predict, follow instructions, and be inspected. It bridges gaps in existing encoders by providing a single representation that supports multiple downstream tasks.
significance: By unifying these capabilities, ALPS advances the versatility and interpretability of world models, paving the way for more robust AI systems.

title: News Archives - Geospatial Artificial Intelligence | GeoAI
headline: GeoAI Launches New Feature Updates and Cutting-Edge Technologies in Latest News Archive
tldr: The GeoAI news archive now highlights recent feature releases and emerging technologies. Stay informed on the latest advancements in geospatial AI.
significance: This update enhances user engagement by providing timely insights into GeoAI's evolving capabilities.

title: GeoAI - Open Source AI Project - Evermx
headline: GeoAI: Open-Source AI Framework for Satellite Imagery Analysis and Visualization
tldr: GeoAI is a Python library that unifies deep learning with geospatial data, enabling rapid analysis of satellite and aerial imagery. Published by the Open Geospatial Solutions community, it offers tools for segmentation, object detection, and change detection across diverse remote sensing modalities.
significance: By providing an open, modular platform, GeoAI accelerates the deployment of AI in environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster response.

title: Object Detection from Remote Sensing Imagery with GeoAI
headline: GeoAI Object Detection in Remote Sensing: From Installation to Model Training
tldr: This notebook walks users through installing GeoAI, downloading satellite imagery, visualizing data, and training an object detection model. It demonstrates a complete pipeline for detecting objects in remote sensing images using open-source tools.
significance: It empowers researchers to quickly prototype and deploy object detection models on satellite imagery, accelerating applications like urban planning and environmental monitoring.

title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
headline: Halcyon: Strong Text-to-Image Generation Without Language Pretraining From Scratch on 100M Image-Text Pairs
tldr: Halcyon demonstrates that large multimodal autoregressive models can be trained from scratch on a 100M image-text dataset, achieving superior performance to models that rely on internet-scale language pretraining. The 0.52B parameter variant surpasses LlamaGen-XL/8 by a significant margin in image quality metrics.
significance: This work challenges the prevailing assumption that language pretraining is essential for high-quality text-to-image generation, opening new avenues for efficient multimodal model training.

title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
headline: OpenVLHarness Empowers Visual Agents with Multimodal Memory for Real-World Tool Use
tldr: OpenVLHarness demonstrates that multimodal memory enables large language models to perform complex visual tasks that require external evidence and numerical measurements. Our study on 22 benchmarks shows that merely increasing inference time is insufficient, highlighting the need for grounded perception and external knowledge.
significance: This work reveals the limitations of current MLLMs and introduces a framework that bridges the gap between internal reasoning and real-world perception, advancing tool-use capabilities.

title: Boundary-Sensitive Quantum Order on Non-Amenable Lattices
headline: Quantum Order Emerges on Non-Amenable Lattice Boundaries in Cayley Tree Systems
tldr: Using boundary-preserving iDMRG and a symmetry-fixing duality, we uncover a novel bulk ordering in p<5 clock models on the infinite Cayley tree, a non-amenable lattice. This ordering appears between the conventional ordered and disordered phases, highlighting the unique role of extensive boundaries.
significance: The discovery demonstrates that non-amenable lattices can host bulk phases without Euclidean analogues, opening new avenues for quantum many-body physics.

title: VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token
headline: VideoMaMa++: Achieving Temporal Consistency in Video Matting with Preserve-and-Refine Tokens
tldr: VideoMaMa++ introduces a preserve-and-refine token strategy to maintain temporal coherence across video frames, overcoming the short inference window of diffusion-based matting models. The method enables efficient, real‑time matting for full-length videos while preserving high-quality alpha mattes.
significance: By extending diffusion-based matting to longer sequences with temporal consistency, VideoMaMa++ paves the way for practical, high‑fidelity video editing and compositing in real‑time applications.

title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
headline: Ropedia W0: First Loco-Manipulation Foundation Model for Humans and Robots
tldr: Ropedia W0 introduces an egocentric world model that jointly learns locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments, bridging humans and robots. The model is trained on the newly curated Xp-Data, offering a benchmark for future loco-manipulation research.
significance: It provides a unified foundation for embodied agents to anticipate action consequences across heterogeneous action spaces, advancing cross-embodiment AI.

title: Physical Words: A Vocabulary for Structuring Latent Reasoning in Robot Manipulation
headline: Bridging Language and Latent Reasoning: Physical Words for Robot Manipulation
tldr: Multimodal reasoning equips robotic foundation models with predictive context, yet language-based reasoning lacks fine-grained physical dynamics. Introducing a structured vocabulary of physical words unifies latent state evolution with reusable reasoning primitives for robust robot manipulation.
significance: This work provides a foundational framework that integrates language semantics with latent dynamics, enabling more reliable and reusable robotic manipulation strategies.

title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
headline: Dynamic Weight Switching: A New Agent Action for Long-Horizon Learning
tldr: Long-horizon agents often forget earlier skills when learning new ones. Dynamic weight switching lets agents activate different capability modules at each trajectory stage, mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
significance: This approach enables agents to retain and flexibly deploy heterogeneous skills without retraining the entire model.

title: GPT-6 Astra Is a Native Visuo-Tactile Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
headline: GPT-6 Astra Enables Real-Time Visuo‑Tactile Control for Contact‑Rich Robotic Manipulation
tldr: GPT-6 Astra, a multimodal foundation model, demonstrates the first direct use of tactile observations for contact‑rich robotic manipulation via in‑context learning. This breakthrough shows that large language models can handle complex sensor fusion tasks in real‑time, opening new possibilities for versatile robotic control.
significance: It proves that large multimodal models can replace specialist tactile policies, simplifying the development of adaptable, real‑time robotic systems.

title: Train An Imaginative Agent
headline: Training Agents to Imagine Before Acting: A New Framework for Sokoban
tldr: We propose Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that encourages agents to simulate consequences before acting. This approach reduces irreversible mistakes in sparse-feedback environments like Sokoban.
significance: Agima enables agents to anticipate and avoid unsolvable states, improving reliability in planning tasks.

title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
headline: Generalizing World Models Beyond Expert Rollouts: Improving Dynamics for Reliable Planning
tldr: World models aim to capture environment dynamics for planning, but they often fail outside expert rollouts. This paper investigates how data coverage affects generalization and proposes methods to improve robustness.
significance: The work highlights a critical bottleneck in deploying world models for real-world decision making, offering insights that could broaden their applicability.

title: Learning to Correct Geometry in Generated Videos
headline: Fixing Geometric Drift in Video Generation: Data-Driven Corrections for Consistent Viewpoints
tldr: Generated videos often lose geometric consistency under camera motion, causing warped structures and inconsistent parallax. This paper shows that the issue stems mainly from data biases and proposes a data-driven correction method that restores spatial coherence.
significance: Improving geometric fidelity in video synthesis enhances realism and reliability for downstream applications like AR/VR and visual storytelling.

title: Rethinking the design space of Vanilla Pixel Diffusion Transformers
headline: Pixel Diffusion Transformers: Direct Image Generation Without Latent Bottlenecks in Pixel Space
tldr: JiT demonstrates that a vanilla diffusion transformer can generate images directly in pixel space by replacing the usual velocity prediction with clean image prediction. This eliminates the need for a lossy latent bottleneck and a separately trained autoencoder, simplifying the pipeline.
significance: This approach streamlines diffusion-based image synthesis, potentially improving fidelity and reducing computational overhead.

title: Flashing with colours: Photometric indicators of an early interaction in type II supernovae
headline: Early Interaction Signals in Type II Supernovae Revealed by Rapid Photometry
tldr: We combine near-daily, high-precision optical photometry of 86 type II supernovae to identify early photometric signatures of circumstellar interaction. The study demonstrates that early color evolution can serve as a diagnostic for progenitor mass loss and explosion physics.
significance: This work provides a new, statistically robust method to probe early supernova environments, informing models of massive star evolution.

title: Bad Diagnosis: Analyzing Consent and Data Collection Practices of Mobile Medical Apps
headline: Unveiling Consent Gaps: 10,000+ mHealth Apps Exposed and Data Practices Revealed
tldr: We analyzed consent and data collection across 10,000+ mHealth apps on Google Play, revealing widespread privacy gaps and inconsistent data handling. The study highlights the need for stricter regulations and better transparency in mobile health applications.
significance: This work provides the first large-scale evidence of privacy shortcomings in mHealth apps, informing policymakers and developers.

title: Entering the Era of Circumplanetary Ring Detection with Direct Imaging
headline: Detecting Exoplanet Rings: A New Frontier in Direct Imaging Observations
tldr: Rings around giant planets are common in our Solar System, but detecting them around exoplanets remains challenging. Upcoming missions like the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will need to account for ring effects to accurately interpret reflected light data.
significance: Understanding circumplanetary rings is essential for correctly characterizing exoplanet atmospheres and potential habitability.

title: Blind Precise Assembly: Proprioceptive Sim-to-Real Peg-in-Hole for Diverse Parts
headline: Proprioceptive Sim-to-Real Peg-in-Hole: Blind Precise Assembly Using Joint Sensors for Diverse Parts
tldr: This work demonstrates that high-resolution joint encoders alone can guide a robot to perform millimeter-scale peg-in-hole tasks without visual feedback. By training a proprioceptive policy in simulation and transferring it to real hardware, the robot reliably aligns and inserts diverse parts under blind conditions.
significance: It shows that proprioception can replace vision for fine assembly, reducing cost and complexity in robotic manufacturing.

title: Behavioral Couplings: From Formation to Behavioral Emergence in Language Models
headline: Fine-Tuning Sparks Unexpected Behaviors and Synergies in Large Language Models
tldr: Fine-tuning LLMs can trigger unintended behaviors, revealing behavioral couplings. This study maps these emergent effects.
significance: Understanding behavioral couplings informs safer model fine-tuning practices.

title: Identifiability from Moments in Independent Component Analysis Mixture Models
headline: Unveiling Identifiability in ICA Mixture Models via Moment Analysis for Statistical Modeling
tldr: This paper demonstrates that ICA mixture models, which generalize Gaussian mixtures, can be uniquely identified from their moments under broad conditions. The authors provide theoretical guarantees and illustrate the implications for nonparametric density estimation.
significance: By establishing moment-based identifiability, the work bridges a gap between ICA theory and practical mixture modeling, enabling more reliable inference in high-dimensional data.

title: AI-Driven Reproducibility and Analytical Robustness in Scientific Discovery
headline: LLM Agents Automate Reproducibility and Robustness in Cancer Research Using SEER
tldr: We demonstrate that large language model agents can automatically reproduce and assess the analytical robustness of scientific findings, reducing manual effort. In a case study on SEER cancer data, the agents replicated key analyses and identified potential biases, showcasing a scalable approach to reproducibility.
significance: This work shows that LLM agents can transform reproducibility from a labor-intensive task into an automated, scalable process, accelerating scientific discovery.

title: ModeCast: One-Shot Prediction of Linear MHD Eigenmodes and Growth Rates in Tokamaks
headline: ModeCast: Rapid One-Shot Prediction of Tokamak MHD Instabilities Using Machine Learning
tldr: ModeCast delivers instant linear stability assessments for tokamak plasmas, replacing hours-long simulations. Trained on thousands of JOREK runs, it predicts eigenmodes and growth rates in a single forward pass.
significance: By enabling real-time stability analysis, ModeCast accelerates fusion design cycles and reduces computational costs.

title: StopWatch: Goal Grounding for Object-goal Navigation
headline: Diagnosing Goal Grounding Failures in Vision‑Language Model Navigation for Object‑Goal Tasks
tldr: Fine‑tuned vision‑language models excel at exploration but struggle to correctly ground target objects, limiting success in object‑goal navigation. Our study pinpoints goal grounding as the primary bottleneck and suggests targeted improvements.
significance: Understanding the root cause of low success rates in VLM‑based navigation guides the development of more reliable autonomous agents.

title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
headline: OmniVerifier-C1: Fine-Grained Decomposition of Rule-Governed Generative Visual Verifiers for Robust Multimodal Intelligence
tldr: OmniVerifier-C1 introduces a graded verifier that decomposes complex prompts and environmental rules into fine-grained components, moving beyond binary judgments. This approach enhances robustness and compositional reasoning in multimodal generative world modeling.
significance: It enables more nuanced verification of generative models, improving reliability in complex multimodal tasks.

title: LSST and Keck characterization of outer Main Belt comet P/2026 N2
headline: LSST and Keck Reveal Persistent Activity of Outer Main Belt Comet P/2026 N2
tldr: Using LSST optical data and Keck/LRIS imaging, we tracked comet P/2026 N2’s active morphology across 102 days around perihelion. Dynamical integrations confirm its outer Main Belt orbit and ongoing activity, highlighting the importance of coordinated surveys.
significance: This study demonstrates the power of combining wide-field survey data with targeted high-resolution imaging to monitor cometary activity in the outer Main Belt.

title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
headline: Rethinking Routing Exploration for Efficient Modern Mixture‑of‑Experts Models in Large Language Systems
tldr: The paper critiques existing routing strategies in Mixture‑of‑Experts (MoE) models, highlighting trade‑offs between expressiveness and activation efficiency. It introduces a novel routing exploration technique that balances these factors, achieving better accuracy and speed on standard benchmarks.
significance: By redefining how tokens are routed to experts, the study enables larger, more efficient MoE models that can be deployed in real‑world AI applications.

title: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
headline: SUPRA-TEX: Super-Aligned Texture for Realistic 3D Mesh Generation from a Single Image
tldr: SUPRA‑TEX introduces a novel approach that aligns texture across views to produce photorealistic, relightable 3D meshes from a single image. By fusing multi‑view predictions without artifacts and preserving fine details through implicit conditioning, it outperforms existing methods on benchmark datasets.
significance: It advances single-image 3D reconstruction, enabling high-fidelity, relightable models for applications in AR/VR and digital content creation.

title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
headline: FDE-Gym: Benchmarking AI Agents on Real-World Delivery Tasks for Forward-Deployed Engineers
tldr: We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks spanning 20 customer scenarios, designed to evaluate AI agents in realistic, ambiguous, live-system contexts. This benchmark pushes agents beyond well-specified tasks, requiring clarification of requirements and discovery of unstated constraints.
significance: FDE-Gym provides the first large-scale, realistic testbed for AI agents, bridging the gap between controlled benchmarks and real-world engineering deployments.

title: Singles in Disguise: Kepler's Low-SNR Single-Transiting Systems as Incompletely Detected Multis
headline: Kepler Singles May Be Hidden Multiplanet Systems, Not a Separate Population
tldr: Kepler’s excess of single transiting planets can be explained by detection biases that miss additional low‑signal planets. The study shows that many singles are actually incomplete detections of multi‑planet systems, challenging the idea of a distinct single‑planet population.
significance: This finding reshapes our understanding of planetary system architectures and suggests that apparent single‑planet systems may largely be incomplete multi‑planet systems.

title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
headline: Speculative Forcing Accelerates Autoregressive Video Generation for Real-Time Streaming without Extra Computation
tldr: Speculative Forcing selectively skips the final denoising step for tokens that already converge, reducing compute while maintaining quality. This approach speeds up few-step autoregressive video generators, enabling efficient real-time streaming.
significance: It allows video generation models to run faster and more efficiently, making real-time streaming practical.

title: Projected sensitivity of a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate comagnetometer to proton monopole-dipole interactions
headline: Spinor BEC Comagnetometer Probes Proton Monopole-Dipole Forces Below Millimeter Scale
tldr: The study projects that a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate comagnetometer can directly constrain proton monopole-dipole interactions at sub‑millimeter ranges, surpassing current neutron‑based limits. This sensitivity opens a new window for detecting light spin‑zero bosons that violate parity and time‑reversal symmetry.
significance: It provides the first direct laboratory limits on proton‑mediated monopole‑dipole forces at short distances, advancing searches for new physics beyond the Standard Model.

title: Spark-0: Scaling Spatially Aligned Tactile Pretraining for Robot Dexterous Manipulation
headline: Spark-0: Spatially Aligned Vision‑Tactile Pretraining for Dexterous Robot Manipulation and Control
tldr: Spark‑0 introduces a vision‑tactile‑language‑action model that aligns tactile contact maps with image space, enabling robots to learn dexterous manipulation tasks from large‑scale pretraining. The model demonstrates improved performance on contact‑rich tasks and offers an open‑source benchmark for future research.
significance: By integrating tactile signals directly into a spatially aligned pretraining framework, Spark‑0 advances the capability of generalist robot policies to handle fine‑grained, contact‑rich manipulation tasks.

title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
headline: 3DCodeVerse: Scalable 3D Content Creation via Coding Agents
tldr: We present 3DCodeVerse, an ecosystem that lets coding agents generate editable, verifiable 3D content at scale. It includes a large curated dataset, a harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding.
significance: 3DCodeVerse enables rapid, reliable development of complex 3D scenes, accelerating research and applications in virtual worlds and simulation.

title: Dexterity from Supervised Play
headline: Robots Learn Dexterity by Playing: Autonomous Data Collection via Supervised Play
tldr: DSP trains a play policy from minutes of human play using behavior cloning, then lets the robot autonomously gather hours of interaction data to build a world model. During deployment, the same play policy guides the robot to perform dexterous tasks in real time.
significance: This approach dramatically reduces the data needed to train robots for complex manipulation, enabling rapid, scalable skill acquisition.

title: Geospatial & AI Trends: Highlights from 2025 - Geoawesome
headline: 2025 GeoAI Trends: Predictive Insights, Automation, and Climate Solutions for Cities and Global Challenges
tldr: 2025 sees GeoAI harnessing satellite imagery and LLMs to forecast climate impacts and optimize urban planning. Emerging diffusion models and real‑time point‑cloud analytics empower proactive disaster response and sustainable agriculture.
significance: These advances enable data‑driven decision making that can mitigate climate risks and improve resource allocation worldwide.

title: GeoAI | Geo Week News
headline: AI and Machine Learning Transform Geospatial Work: From Feature Extraction to Predictive Analysis
tldr: Artificial intelligence and machine learning are revolutionizing geospatial workflows by automating feature extraction, classifying point clouds, and enabling predictive analytics across the data pipeline. GeoAI blends AI with imagery, LiDAR, and spatial datasets at scale, unlocking new applications in mapping, monitoring, and decision-making.
significance: These advances accelerate insight generation, reduce manual effort, and empower real-time decision-making in diverse sectors.

title: Towards the next generation of Geospatial Artificial Intelligence
headline: Charting the Future of GeoAI: Emerging Trends and Next-Gen Opportunities
tldr: GeoAI blends geospatial science with AI, rapidly evolving across spatial data science. The paper reviews recent advances and projects future directions.
significance: Understanding GeoAI’s trajectory is crucial for leveraging AI in spatial decision-making and policy.

title: GeoAI and the Next Generation of Geospatial Insights - Geo Week News
headline: GeoAI Revolutionizes Geospatial Insight: AI, Data, and Sensing Merge for Smarter Mapping
tldr: Artificial intelligence is reshaping geospatial analysis by merging data, sensing, and AI. GeoAI promises faster, more accurate mapping and decision-making across industries.
significance: GeoAI will transform how organizations collect, analyze, and act on spatial data, enabling real-time insights and smarter resource management.

title: ACMSIGSPATIAL-GEOAI 2025 - Conference Tagline
headline: Harnessing Deep Learning for Geospatial Insight: AI Meets Multimodal Data
tldr: The conference showcases breakthroughs in AI and hardware that enable automated learning from massive multimodal geospatial data. These advances transform societal challenges across urban planning, agriculture, and disaster response.
significance: By integrating cutting‑edge deep learning with multimodal geospatial data, the event accelerates solutions for real‑world problems.
